head_commit.message:
Run the offline CI on every pull request to develop

The three-platform CI passes on develop now that the Windows and encoding
fixes are in (#273, #274, #275), so it runs on each pull request to
develop as well as by hand. The testing doc describes the runs and the
kept test results.

head_commit.message:
Stop real-time scanning on the Windows CI runner

The runner's Defender scans every file the tests write, and a Run's saves
write thousands. The step runs only on the disposable CI machine.

head_commit.message:
Retry a saved file shared for a moment on Windows

Windows cannot open a file while it is being replaced, nor replace a file
another handle has open. A status read that met a save answered HTTP 500
in the CI's end-to-end test. Reads of saved JSON and the replaces of
saves and cached frames now retry for up to half a second on Windows.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

head_commit.message:
Give ctypes the Windows handle types when reading peak memory

Without them ctypes passed the process handle as a C int, so the call
failed on 64-bit Windows and no peak RSS was recorded.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

head_commit.message:
Run the offline CI on Linux, Windows and macOS

The workflow tested Linux only, one test at a time. It now runs the same
offline tests on ubuntu, windows and macos runners in parallel workers,
keeps each platform's test results, and lints once on Linux. It is still
started by hand while the other platforms' failures are sorted out.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
